map.算法：按绝热压缩，绝热指数 k=1.4、进气绝压 p1=0.101325MPa；: Algorithm: assume adiabatic compression with k = 1.4 and inlet absolute pressure p1 = 0.101325MPa; discharge absolute pressure p2 = p1 + gauge pressure; compression ratio = p2/p1; adiabatic power W = k/(k-1) x p1 x 1e6 x Qs x ((p2/p1)^((k-1)/k) - 1).

map.实际冷却有限、过程接近绝热，绝热功率是选型保守上限；多级+中冷可逼近等温: Real cooling is limited and the process is close to adiabatic, so the adiabatic power is a conservative upper bound for selection; multi-stage with intercooling approaches the isothermal case.
map.比功率 = 轴功率/排气量（kW/(m³/min)），越低越节能，可与 GB 1: Specific power = shaft power / displacement (kW/(m3/min)); lower is better, comparable with GB 19153
map.排气压力越高、压缩比越大，功耗与温升显著上升: The higher the discharge pressure and compression ratio, the higher the power and temperature rise
map.选型应留余量并考虑储气罐与后处理配置: Selection should leave margin and consider the air receiver and after-treatment configuration
map.实际压缩机冷却有限、过程接近绝热，绝热功率是选型的保守上限；带完善中间冷却的多级: Real compressors cool only partly and the process is close to adiabatic, so the adiabatic power is a conservative upper bound for selection; multi-stage compression with good intercooling approaches isothermal conditions and uses clearly less power, which is why large units commonly use multi-stage compression.
map.比功率怎么用来判断能效？: How Is Specific Power Used to Judge Efficiency?
map.比功率 = 轴功率/排气量（kW/(m³/min)），是容积式空压机能效分级的核: Specific power = shaft power / displacement (kW/(m3/min)) and it is the core metric for energy-efficiency grading of positive displacement compressors. At the same discharge pressure, lower specific power means better efficiency, and it can be compared with the GB 19153 limits and the energy-efficiency benchmark values.
